name: session-continuity
description: Bootstrap repository task states and resume ordinary Codex sessions with verified checkpoints.

interface.shortDescription: 일반 Codex 세션의 작업 상태 초기화, 재개 및 체크포인트
interface.longDescription: Initialize repository continuity rules and task states without replacing existing work. Resume by comparing AGENTS.md, state, Git and relevant files; record actual verification evidence and prepare checkpoints or task completion. Uses ordinary Codex sessions without requiring leader/worker orchestration. When an orchestrator is already in use, keep one task recovery point and reference worker details rather than duplicating overall state. Optional helpers require Python 3.9+ and Git.
defaultPrompt: Use $session-continuity to initialize task continuity in this repository while preserving existing rules and work.
Use $session-continuity to resume the requested task from its state and actual repository evidence.
